TABLE.NAME: local_chirpvoice_course_settings
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course language restrictions for AI SCORM Voiceover

FIELD.NAME: allowedlanguages
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated language codes the teacher has enabled for this course. NULL means inherit from admin settings.

FIELD.NAME: voice
FIELD.COMMENT: Voice name chosen by teacher for this course (e.g. Aoede). NULL means inherit from admin default.
